corrections.issue: ZOY (N-[(4S)-4,5-diamino-5-oxopentyl]-10-phenyldecanamide) is a covalent staple+lipid on the peptide, bonded at two points (ZOY.N--TPO5.C amide and ZOY.C16--ALA3.CB) forming a macrocycle, but it was filed in receptor_NN.cif and recorded only as a pose_env_adduct, so pose_NN.sdf/cif represented the peptide without it (and TPO5 as a malformed free C-terminus).
corrections.fix: Moved ZOY into pose_NN.cif and pose_NN.sdf with both inter-residue bonds; removed it from receptor_NN.cif. Mirrors the 4PJZ/T55 correction (2026-09-15).
corrections.note: pose_env_adducts and the peptide seq/token fields still describe the pre-correction peptide and were not recomputed; the pose structure files are authoritative.

provenance.frame_receptor_from: PDB 7MX1 receptor, used as the common reference frame (shipped as receptor.cif)
provenance.per_pose_receptors: receptor_NN.cif pairs with pose_NN.cif; each is that pose's own assembly copy in the reference frame

poses.label: C/-
poses.transform: receptor subchain A superposed onto B by residue number, 220 CA, 0.55 A
